mathematicalReview.null: Marginal distribution for each tested outcome equals projecting the same complete-vector within-institute time-permutation null. No cross-outcome maximum or joint-tail statistic is substituted.
mathematicalReview.multiplicity: Each distinct scalar assignment represents product(frequency!) labeled permutations; primary streams assignments and restores this constant factor. Independent DP instead multiplies each branch by remaining labeled choices, with factorial suffix for a sole remaining outcome.
mathematicalReview.statistic: With u=2t, c_i=n*u_i-sum(u), weekly OLS slope is14*sum(c_i*y_i)/(n*sum(u_i^2)-sum(u_i)^2). Independent pairwise-square denominator equals the same quantity.
mathematicalReview.independence: Primary unique-assignment recursion and independent remaining-count/score DP use separate count recurrences; frozen combined tails still use searchsorted versus direct monotone-sweep algorithms. Common input validation and class carrier do not generate either recurrence.
mathematicalReview.tolerance: Frozen combined tails retain1e-12 inclusive cutoff. Primary individual1e-12 and legacy independent-party1e-10 are preserved by exact textual substitutions.
mathematicalReview.weightsCohortBhSignFlips: Frozen analyzers pinned by SHA; wrapper substitutions replace distribution construction and output/input destinations only, preserving statistic, fieldwork cohort, weights, BH families and sign flips.
mathematicalReview.mass: Python integer histogram counts and totals; object multiplicity arrays whenever rawmass exceeds signed64; frozen combined counters promote products and tail accumulation beyond signed64.
